channel.title: The Average Enthusiasts
channel.description: We're not great at anything, but we're enthusiastic about a lot! A podcast by Brandon Martinez and Kenny Graham, 2017-2021. The show has ended; the complete archive of all 38 episodes lives at https://www.theaverageenthusiasts.com .

item.description: Finances: one of the many interesting aspects in a relationship. Brandon and Kenny catch up and talk about staying in their financial lanes within their marriages, and share some kind-of-helpful and kind-of-not financial tips.

item.title: #TAE 033: Poor Cinema Culture
item.description: Kenny learns that Brandon is very, very uncultured in his cinema tastes – so much so that he can't even name a favorite movie! The duo explores some of their favorite movies, while Kenny tries to drag a true favorite out of Brandon.
